reasons: Section 21.1 matches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees 'paid or payable' in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000, with express mutuality language.

21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully characterises data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs as direct damages — a term favourable to us.

21.3 'Excluded Claims' sits outside both the cap and the exclusion and covers confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligation is not capped 'damages'.

Resolved 'Fees' (1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap basis is meaningful, not illusory; the exclusion of the one-time implementation charge is correctly noted as a minor point mitigated by the USD 1,000,000 floor rather than raised as a deviation.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and the deterministic checks (12-month/fixed-floor basis; no unlimited Customer liability) both pass.
